main_body: Large round leaf canopy (rows 0-31) on a short brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Canopy is lit from above: lighter green clumps in the upper rows (about rows 1-12) over mid and dark greens lower down; no separate flat band. The trunk below is a vertical face.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The rounded canopy mass is shaded light at the top and dark underneath, and the dark underside of the canopy shades the trunk top. The trunk is a vertical front face with a grass base. There is no hard architectural top and front, but an organic canopy is read through its volumetric shading, and it reads as a plausible 3/4 tree. The canopy is lit from above and dark underneath, so it works as a rounded volume.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps (deep, dark, mid, light, highlight) grouped in blocky clumps, and the outline is a dark teal-green tone that follows the leaves rather than black. Clumps are chunky and lack the per-leaf dots and scalloped edge detail of the Beodeul references, which have jagged leaf-cluster silhouettes and bright highlight dabs. The trunk is a plain narrow brown column with only 3-4 tones and no roots or bark texture. Overall it is cleaner and smoother, thinner than the references, but not flat or sticker-like.
